quota.note: UNKNOWN is not exhaustion; Pack024 owns observations and Pack027 may rank LIMITED lower.

margin.liveLegacyCompatibility: Existing aiRouter callers are already gated upstream by financial/plan logic; until Pack028 supplies a measured router decision receipt, aiRouter bridges omitted quote to the configured minimum. Explicit quotes below the floor are blocked.

authorization.liveLegacyCompatibility: Existing aiRouter entrypoints are already gated upstream. Omitted entitlement/permission flags preserve that contract; an explicit false is fail-closed.
authorization.futureCallers: Should pass explicit entitlementAllowed and permissionAllowed booleans.

fallback.rule: The fallback chain is filtered once before any provider attempt; a filtered route cannot re-enter later in the loop.
